audits.claim: Deferring SendGrid cancellation to a 15-minute cron allows an already-scheduled reminder to send after its booking is cancelled.
audits.evidence: packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts:484-492 invokes deleteScheduledEmailReminder with no immediateDelete flag, and packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/emailReminderManager.ts:213-232 then only sets cancelled=true instead of contacting SendGrid. The same file at lines 159-176 has already queued the email with sendAt and stored its batch ID. For example, cancel at 12:01 a reminder queued for 12:05 after the 12:00 cron: .github/workflows/cron-scheduleEmailReminders.yml:6-8 schedules the next cancellation pass at 12:15, so no cancellation request precedes sendAt. packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:34-41 then deletes the expired row before the cancellation loop at lines 44-64 can see it; the supplied diff shows the prior helper sent the cancellation immediately.

audits.claim: The reschedule try/catch does not catch failures from the asynchronous reminder-cancellation helpers.
audits.evidence: packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts:964-974 calls both helpers inside a synchronous forEach without awaiting their returned promises, so asynchronous failures cannot reach that catch. Moreover, packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/emailReminderManager.ts:202-235 and packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/smsReminderManager.ts:177-189 catch their own operation errors and log them. The outer error message is thus ineffective for helper failures, although an unrelated synchronous error traversing the array could technically reach it. This comment principally identifies misleading error-handling structure; the broader cancellation-lifetime issue is already reported separately in finding 2.

audits.claim: The PR leaves Prisma unused in workflows.tsx and changes type-only imports to ordinary imports.
audits.evidence: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/workflows.tsx:1-10 imports Prisma and PrismaPromise as ordinary named imports and omits a trailing comma after Prisma. The only other PrismaPromise occurrence is the type annotation at line 342, and Prisma has no other occurrence in this file. packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts:1-12 likewise combines the previously type-only names with runtime enum imports, as confirmed by the supplied diff. These are import/formatting cleanup concerns; the source does not establish that the compiler will retain unused type-only imports or that they cause a runtime failure.

audits.claim: The PR changes indentation in a disabled workflow sample block without changing its behavior.
audits.evidence: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/workflows.tsx:901 opens the block comment containing the sample code at lines 902-962. The supplied diff's final workflows.tsx hunk removes indentation from those statements while retaining their text. These changes cannot affect execution because the statements remain commented out; the complaint is valid only as review noise and unrelated formatting churn.
